normalized.result:
The simple one-page layout, newest-first order, and empty-state message all feel right. Pasting a link and pressing Save is the quick capture I had in mind.

The generated label isn’t enough, though. I’d expect the app to collect the page’s real title and short description, along with its site icon and preview image when available. I should be able to correct the title or description before saving and edit them afterward.

Also, saving the same address again shouldn’t add a duplicate. It should tell me I already have it and take me to the existing bookmark so I can edit it. Once those behaviours are represented, this save step will feel right.
